Hi Team Transpeed Logistics,

I was checking out commercial freight and transport operators in Andheri East, Mumbai and came across your business.

The #1 bottleneck in freight right now is quote turnaround time: shippers searching for trucks request 3 quotes and book the first one who responds within 15 minutes. We build direct WhatsApp freight rate estimators and automated dispatch bots that capture shippers instantly and help fleet operators bypass 15-25% broker commissions.

Would you be open to a 5-minute screen share this week to see how this works for your lane routes?

Warm regards,
Freight Automation & Tech Team
